self_review_definition: receipt.second_reviewer equals the reviewer value of the same test_id row in reviews/*.jsonl; resolved receipts whose final_review.reviewer equals their own second_reviewer remain valid second reviews because the reviews row reviewer still differs (see self_review_notes).

self_review_notes.policy: The 13 resolved receipts whose final_review.reviewer is their second_reviewer were checked against reviews/*.jsonl and are kept valid; their author rows are shard reviewers (extensions-installed-pi-001, other-rust-integration-006, public-delegation-002/003, runtime-server-session-001/002).

discounted_requirement_note: No receipt was discounted: zero receipts have second_reviewer equal to their reviews/*.jsonl row reviewer.
